integrity: The line-stabilizer computation is exact over \(\mathbf Q(\zeta_7,a)\), after an irreducibility check for the degree-seven extension. The projective automorphism group is closed exactly to order \(168\); finite sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only the symmetric-theta fibre of the Klein quartic over \(\mathbf C\).
It proves the constituent-line orbit and coset partition, not analogous statements for generic quartics or other theta-characteristic fibres.
The originality conclusion is bounded by the inspected modern literature and semantic/public searches; an older equivalent formulation remains a residual risk.
title: The symmetric Klein-heptagon fibre partitions a regular \(168\)-line orbit
